{{Quote|Why, sure. It's a General Spacetronics ''MaKing''-class transport. The rear flanges mean it's the Janako model &mdash; made locally under license. Looks to me like there's some kind of modification around the gunports &mdash; may have been upgunned. Could be trouble.|Roark Garnet|<ref name="TRG1-34" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] encountered a '''Janako''' model [[MaKing-class transport|''MaKing''-class transport]]. A [[General Spacetronics]] design which was built under a local license, the Janako featured the rear flanges unique to that model of ship. Modifications had also been made around the gunports, and Garnet felt the ship's firepower had been upgraded from its original specifications.<ref name="TRG1-34" />
